poolside.name: Poolside
poolside.description: A sunny pool area with lounge chairs and sparkling water
poolside.atmosphere: The sparkling blue pool glistens under the sunlight. Lounge chairs are scattered around, some with towels draped over them. The scent of chlorine mixes with coconut sunscreen. Water drips from the edge of the pool, creating small ripples. It's warm and inviting, with the sound of water lapping gently. The air is humid and heated.
detail_variants: A lone leaf drifts across the pool surface, catching the light.
The distant hum of the pool pump vibrates softly through the ground.
Sunlight through the pool fence casts long, shifting shadows on the deck.
The sharp, clean smell of wet tile is overpowering in the afternoon heat.
A plastic float bobs gently against the pool edge with a soft, rhythmic thud.

living_room.name: Living Room
living_room.description: Cozy living room with a comfortable couch
living_room.atmosphere: The living room is warm and inviting. A large couch dominates the space, perfect for lounging. The TV is on but muted. Soft lighting from lamps creates a relaxed atmosphere. The air smells of home—a mix of fabric softener and subtle air freshener. It's comfortable and casual.
detail_variants: The couch springs give with a soft creak when you shift your weight.
A faint static hum from the muted TV mingles with the warmth of the room.
A worn throw blanket has a patch of brighter sun on one corner from the window.
The air carries the soft, sweet scent of the laundry basket in the corner.
Light from the lamp creates a small pool of gold on the coffee table.

kitchen.name: Kitchen
kitchen.description: Modern kitchen with counters and appliances
kitchen.atmosphere: The kitchen is clean and modern. Sunlight streams through the window. The counter is cool marble, perfect for leaning against. The fridge hums quietly in the background. There's a faint scent of coffee or something freshly cooked. It's domestic and intimate.
detail_variants: The cold marble counter seeps a sharp chill up through your forearms.
The fridge's low hum dips briefly as the compressor cycles off, then resumes.
A faint steam ghost rises from the coffee pot, carrying the smell of dark roast.
Light through the window catches the glass jars, throwing tiny prismatic streaks on the tile.
The sink drain gurgles faintly, a small domestic sound that fills the silence.

beach.name: Beach
beach.atmosphere: The beach stretches out with golden sand and crashing waves. The sun beats down, making everything warm. The salty ocean air fills your lungs. Seagulls cry overhead. The sound of waves is constant and soothing. It's open, free, and perfect for summer fun.
detail_variants: A thin layer of sand sifts between your toes with every step.
The salt crust on your skin tingles as the warm air dries it.
A seagull cries overhead, its shadow sweeping across the water.
The next wave pulls back with a soft, slapping hiss as it retreats.
Heat shimmer ripples the horizon, blurring where sand meets sky.

school_classroom.name: School Classroom
school_classroom.atmosphere: The classroom is empty and quiet—school has ended for the day. Desks are arranged in neat rows. The chalkboard has some writing left on it. Sunlight streams through the windows, casting long shadows. The air smells of chalk dust and paper. It's private and slightly forbidden.
detail_variants: A single dust mote floats through a warm shaft of afternoon sun.
The chalkboard still carries the smudged ghost of someone's last erasure.
One desk creaks faintly, as if it still holds the shape of whoever sat there last.
The quiet of the empty room makes your own breathing feel loud.
The fluorescent tube above the last row flickers, buzzes, then settles.

gym.name: Gym
gym.description: Workout gym with equipment and mirrors
gym.atmosphere: The gym is filled with equipment and floor-to-ceiling mirrors. The air smells of sweat and rubber. Music plays from speakers. The temperature is warm from body heat and exertion. Everything is clean but well-used. The mirrors reflect every angle.
detail_variants: The rubber floor mats warm slightly under your feet with every landing.
A low thud echoes as a dumbbell is set down somewhere off-frame.
The bass from the speaker stack vibrates in your chest more than your ears.
The mirrors show your reflection moving in perfect, tireless synchrony.
The smell of warm rubber and metallic sweat clings to the front of your shirt.

movie_theater.name: Movie Theater
movie_theater.description: Dark movie theater during a film
movie_theater.atmosphere: The movie theater is dark, with only the screen providing flickering light. The seats are comfortable and reclined. The sound system booms, covering other noises. The air smells of popcorn and candy. It's public but anonymous in the darkness. Perfect for sneaky touching.
detail_variants: The seat recline groans softly as it settles into a new angle.
Popcorn shells crunch somewhere in the dark to your left.
The screen's flicker casts a blue-white light that pulses across the seats.
The sweet, warm smell of caramel popcorn clings to the air.
The sub-bass hum of a quiet scene rattles the cupholder at your feet.
